mapper.select: select id, yonghu_id as yonghuId, gonghao, xingming, xingbie, shouji, zhicheng, ruzhi_riqi as ruzhiRiqi, zhuangtai, beizhu from huli_renyuan where zhuangtai != '离职' order by id desc
mapper.update: update huli_renyuan set yonghu_id = #{yonghuId}, gonghao = #{gonghao}, xingming = #{xingming}, xingbie = #{xingbie}, shouji = #{shouji}, zhicheng = #{zhicheng}, ruzhi_riqi = #{ruzhiRiqi}, zhuangtai = #{zhuangtai}, beizhu = #{beizhu} where id = #{id}
update huli_renyuan set zhuangtai = '离职' where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select rl.id as guanxiId, rl.huli_renyuan_id as huliRenyuanId, rl.laoren_id as laorenId, l.laoren_bianhao as laorenBianhao, l.xingming as laorenXingming, rl.kaishi_riqi as kaishiRiqi, rl.jieshu_riqi as jieshuRiqi, rl.zhuangtai, rl.beizhu from renyuan_laoren rl join laoren_xinxi l on rl.laoren_id = l.id where rl.huli_renyuan_id = #{huliRenyuanId} and rl.zhuangtai = '服务中' order by rl.id desc

select l.id, l.laoren_bianhao as laorenBianhao, l.xingming, l.xingbie, l.nianling, l.ruzhu_zhuangtai as ruzhuZhuangtai from laoren_xinxi l where l.ruzhu_zhuangtai != '已删除' and not exists ( select 1 from renyuan_laoren rl where rl.laoren_id = l.id and rl.huli_renyuan_id = #{huliRenyuanId} and rl.zhuangtai = '服务中' )
and l.xingming like concat('%', #{laorenXingming}, '%')
order by l.id desc
